title: GateMem B2 deletion-speech precision and coverage audit

deviations: The two exact upstream positive probes were selected after inspecting public dialogue language, so this is a development audit and those probes cannot be reused as clean confirmation data.
The synthetic probes were not preregistered.

dataset.name: GateMem public household dialogue plus paired synthetic speech acts
dataset.license: Code MIT; dataset terms unresolved in the pinned repository card

results.primary_outcome: DELETE signal emission by speech-act class
results.contract_mismatch: The production regex requires an information referent for forget, despite the prototype review saying forget remained intrinsically cognitive.
results.global_state_note: The safe module mutates base parser regex globals and package initialization imports the safe module eagerly.

cost.note: Local deterministic audit; no hosted-model API charge.

claim_boundary: Development language-coverage counterexample at one frozen PR head; not an official GateMem score, recall estimate, or held-out confirmation.
